page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with marginal notes in the right margin. The text block is in the centre-left. Two notes stand in the right margin, beside the paragraphs on odour distinctions. Below the text: signature "E" at the centre foot and catchword "Au-" at the right.

p.i: Finis odoris ratione brutorum, est alimentum a non alimento discernere, cujus signum est, quod animalia non capiantur odoribus.
Ratione hominum est delectatio, & sanita-tis conservatio confirmatioq;

main_text.p: Inde omne corpus est odoriferum, aut odoris expers. Odoriferum est, vel bene, vel male olens.
Odores cum in ficco sapido, contemperato singulari ratione cum humido insint, Saporibus plerumq; suam distin-ctionem acceptam referunt.
Esto igitur Odor alius Extremus, a-Odoris di-stinctio.lius Medius.
Extremus habet genera duo: prius est Εὐώδης, posterius δυσώδης.
Εὐώδης est odor gratus, seu fragrantia, ex ficci in humido congrue temperati resolutione orta, suaviter odoratum afficiens.Odor Εὐώδης

p.i: Hic odor cum ad delectationem, tum ad sanitatis custodiam, ad instaurandos & reficiendos spiritus, ad cerebri frigidam & humidam intemperiem corrigendam, memoriamq; stabiliendam, & sensus confirmandos multum confert.

page.notes: The first paragraph is set in italic and may continue from the previous page; the fragment opening it is kept as printed.
